With respect to Target Vitals for instance, are the two cards which
are being "discarded" to cancel the card considered "played", and

cheers

Dark Influences [KoT:U]
Cardtype: Master
Cost: 2 pool
Master: out-of-turn.
Cancel a minion card as it is played. No cost is paid. That card
cannot be played again for the remainder of the turn. Put this card in
play. The next card played that would cancel another Methuselah's
minion card as it is played is canceled (no cost) and this card is
burned instead.

Target Vitals [LotN:U]
Cardtype: Combat
Aim. Play when choosing a strike.
If any damage from this strike is successfully inflicted on the
opposing minion, he or she takes an additional 2 damage from this
strike, and he or she cannot press this round. The opposing minion may
discard two combat cards [COMBAT] to cancel this card. A minion may
play only one aim each strike.

> have my DI suddened, may I still discard 2 combat cards to cancell

Why wouldn't you? You can't DI instead of discarding two cards.

You either DI it, in which case the option of discarding two cards doesnt
become available or you don't DI it (or it gets suddened).

On Jan 12, 4:36 pm, wedge <matt...@gmail.com> wrote:

> Right, for some reason, I thought the timing (cancel) was the same for
> both cards, not that that would make a difference.
>
> I guess.
>
> Does that mean the 'cancel' on Target Vitals is not restricted to when
> this card is played?

You're still in the "as played" phase where you can cancel things.
Similarly, if Player A tries to DI a Freak Drive and it gets Suddenly
Reversed, Player B can still play a DI to cancel that Freak Drive. I
don't see why it would be different with Target Vitals (so if your DI
gets cancelled, you should still be able to discard 2 combat cards).

Messages.Author: YY
Messages.Body:


Moot. V:tES does not have a true 'on the stack' timing for cards
played. Once DI is played (and not canceled), TV is canceled as it is
played (i.e. card text is canceled and thus non-existent), so there is
no available option to discard combat cards to cancel TV (since the
text that allows that has been canceled too).

- YY
